purpose: The set of symbols REFERENCED (as an undefined symbol, i.e. through a relocation) by any input of the app link.  A symbol our tree defines and that is NOT in this set is referenced by nothing outside its own object, which is the actual precondition for internal linkage.  A source-text scan cannot answer this: newlib's libc_nano.a references `_sbrk_r' and no .c file in this repository mentions it.
